content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Spartanburg

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background, then gather proof of your education and project experience. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can verify your qualifications before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all scheduled sessions from your Spartanburg location or anywhere with internet access. This formal education satisfies PMI's required contact-hour prerequisite and covers the PMBOK Guide framework and real-world application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training, submit your official PMI PMP application online, including proof of education and project experience. Pay the required exam fee and allow time for PMI to review and approve your application before you schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study guides, to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through Pearson VUE and sit for the test on your chosen date. Your instructor-led training provides the foundation; focused review solidifies your readiness.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) across the standard 3-year renewal cycle to maintain your credential. Granite PM Academy and PMI offer multiple ways to earn PDUs through courses, volunteer service, and professional engagement. Plan your renewal strategy early to ensure continuous credential status.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
